meta.title: "Reopen Line Items" is offered only on staggered rounds and only after a line has expired
gaps: Check a live staggered auction before any line expires: Reopen Line Items must be disabled with tooltip "Line items can only be reopened if at least one line item has expired"; the prepared event is a fixed RFQ.
Check that Reopen Line Items becomes enabled after line 1 expires in the same staggered auction.
Verify visibility on eligible staggered auctions in live and buffer (evaluation) status and absence outside those statuses.
